items.quote: San Tamake led root cause analysis of recurring service failures across the department.
He led media interviews and press conferences across the department.
He championed the redesign of the citizen journey for permits and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
San Tamake drove upholding governance and audit standards for the whole division.
He spearheaded the crisis response to a major system outage at the national level.
San delivered his share of the partnership with sister agencies on youth services reliably.
